description: Squid BBS Intro by cld & The Doctor, a 1,899-byte BBS advert with AdLib music, running in your browser.
about: A 1,899-byte BBS advert with its own AdLib music player, written by cld & The Doctor in early 1994 and released with its source, commented in Portuguese.
terms: Freeware: “you are free to use it as you want - but DO NOT make another small addy just changing the text and few bytes of code!” (SQUID1.ASM)
accuracy: It runs on a plain VGA (DOSBox's vgaonly), which draws its gradient and raster bars as a real VGA does. Reds and blues then have half the shades.
imageAlt: Squid BBS Intro's lettering over its raster bars, running in DosKit
